title: finding(app-shell,security): search result labels are built from the raw served row — CommandPalette, SearchResultsPage and global-search label a hit through `getRecordDisplayName` with no field-level read gate (a sibling of objectui#10434)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a render probe. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from objectui#10434 (PR objectui#10491, class a), as its ACCEPT promised. The dev probed it, and the PR's contract review confirmed it by reading. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

objectui#10434 gates the record title at the detail hosts (the row with policy-denied fields removed, objectui#10411's `!perms.isLoaded || perms.checkField(object, f, 'read')`). The three search surfaces label a hit the old way:
- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`;
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/SearchResultsPage.tsx`;
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/global-search-renderer.tsx`.

Each passes `getDisplayName: getRecordDisplayName` to `useRecordSearch` (`packages/react/src/hooks/useRecordSearch.ts`), which labels a hit from the served row. None of the four files reads a permission: no `usePermissions`, no `checkField`.

Probe (the objectui#10434 dev, scratch `renderHook` with `CommandPalette`'s exact wiring, real `PermissionProvider` denying `email`, the object's `titleFormat: '{email}'`, a backend that does not strip): the hit is labelled `ada@example.com`.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- **Defence in depth**, as objectui#10434: ObjectStack's `FieldMasker` deletes denied keys server-side.
- **The likely shape:** gate the row before `getDisplayName` sees it, once, at the shared seam. That is either `useRecordSearch` taking a read policy, or the app-shell callers wrapping `getRecordDisplayName` with the gated row. The hook lives in `@object-ui/react`, so check which package holds a permission source.
- **The rule has several spellings.** The field-read rule is spelled in `LookupField.tsx`, `RecordPickerDialog.tsx` and objectui#10434's two copies; decide whether this sibling earns one shared export.
- **Siblings:** objectui#10499 (`page:header`), and the lookup cell (filed in the same act).

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `useRecordSearch` / `CommandPalette` / `SearchResultsPage` / `global-search` near FLS / `checkField` / permission / denied ⇒ 0 hits.

Dedupe words: `useRecordSearch display name FLS` · `CommandPalette denied field label` · `search hit titleFormat permission`
